title: Vanilla+ by yoroff
body:
# Story of this pack

I initially built this modpack strictly for myself to enjoy the perfect, lag-free cooperative experience with my friends—but it turned out too good not to share! 

This pack is the ultimate enhancement of the base game, focusing heavily on incredible performance, immersive audio, and beautiful aesthetic upgrades. Thanks to a meticulously optimized engine core (featuring Sodium, Iris, Lithium, and Indium), you can finally run heavy shaders with smooth, stable FPS. Explore redesigned structures, enjoy realistic sound physics, cook delicious meals, and build cozy bases without any of the typical modded clutter. 

Perfect for solo worlds or co-op servers.
